decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service lies outside the core maritime direction and gets only mentions, but having launched it in 2023 and kept it on the website through 2024, management will likely keep it and attribute weak results to ramp-up.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds on BSM's crewing competence and has been visibly maintained since 2023, so management will persist with it despite the limited evidence of results.

The BSM Smart Academy was publicly launched with its own page and a growing partner network of six maritime institutions, which creates strong public commitment and fits the firm's announced direction.

FuelEU monitoring and compliance services are regulation-driven, central to the firm's announced decarbonisation direction, and already shown to deliver results, since all plans were transferred before the deadline.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the PAL ship management software and supports the compliance offering, so the investment and integration favour keeping it.
The FuelEU cost simulator is integrated into PAL alongside the dashboard and the compliance service, so management will keep it as part of its committed FuelEU package.
